# Paths that may exist in this repository. Checked in CI by tools/check_paths.py.
#
# This repository holds the MCP server: source, tests, fixtures, installer, CI and user
# documentation. Working notes, design drafts, plans, reviews and editor or assistant
# configuration do not belong here. A new file outside these patterns fails CI; if it
# really belongs to the product, add a pattern here in the same pull request.
#
# Syntax: one glob per line, relative to the repository root. '*' matches within one path
# segment, '**' across segments. A line starting with '!' excludes; the last matching line
# wins. Matching is case-sensitive.
